# flip-pdf

> Turn a PDF into a virtual flipbook with a curved, physical page-turn animation. One script tag, no dependencies beyond the bundled PDF.js, MIT licensed.

flip-pdf is a browser library that renders a PDF as a two-page spread and animates sheet turns as real curved paper geometry in WebGL, with a Canvas 2D fallback. The page is a rasterised canvas, so it is for presentation, not for text extraction or search.

Integration, in full:

```html
<script src="flip-pdf.js" defer></script>
<div data-flip-pdf data-src="/document.pdf" style="height: 620px"></div>
```

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/HaysamSalik/flip-pdf/blob/main/AGENTS.md): integration guide written for coding agents, with the API, events, options and the mistakes that break it
- [README.md](https://github.com/HaysamSalik/flip-pdf/blob/main/README.md): full option table, motion and accessibility notes, browser support
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/HaysamSalik/flip-pdf/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the sheet geometry, renderers and page cache fit together

## API

- `new Flipbook(element, options?)`
- `load(source): Promise<Flipbook>`, `next()`, `prev()`, `goToPage(index)`, `goToSpread(spread)`, `destroy()`
- `on(type, handler): () => void` for `ready`, `pagechange`, `warning`, `error`
- Auto-init: every `[data-flip-pdf]` element, with `data-src` and any other `data-*` as options

## Constraints

- The container must have an explicit height.
- Serve over HTTP; `file://` cannot load the worker or the PDF.
- The default worker is a blob URL and needs `worker-src blob:` under a strict CSP. Otherwise pass `workerSrc` and link `flip-pdf.css`.
